doc.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Time Out for Decca and the Columbia record
summary: He discusses the 1958 Decca date with Hank Jones and Ralph Burns and his later Columbia small group.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: In 1958, for Decca Records, Time Out.
Yeah. That period, I’m not so crazy anymore about that. That was with Hank Jones, I think, yes. And Burns, the arranger for…
Ralph Burns, yes. Over the [year?] [inaudible]. I remember Watkins, the bass player.

Doug Watkins. He had a good sound and a good feeling. And Art Taylor and Hank Jones. And on my record that I make for Columbia, there was [Bobi?] [makes sounds], small group type thing, with Ray Brian, Wendell Marshall, who used to play with Duke Ellington and Billy Hart, the drummer.
